title: After Speck: Tip Top, the firewood hall and the remodeled Moulin Rouge
summary: After the war Speck quits, the band plays at various halls, and he discusses the new owner, the cocktail lounge rents and the burnt-down building.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
